description: issue #207: `show_turtle`/`hide_turtle` take no arguments; the parenthesized form `(show_turtle 1)` supplies one, raising `ol-too-many-inputs` at runtime (the bare form's extra tokens would instead fail at parse time as a stray-token diagnostic, since show_turtle/hide_turtle's registered arity is 0 - see packages/parser/src/signatures.ts). Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
